acceptance: tmpd="$(mktemp -d)"; go run ./cmd/telltail local run --dir "$tmpd" --worker telltail-smoke --command "printf TELLTAIL_LOCAL_OK" --trace "$tmpd/shift.jsonl" && go run ./cmd/telltail trace verify "$tmpd/shift.jsonl"
tmpm="$(mktemp -d)"; go run ./cmd/telltail mirror init --dir "$tmpm" && test -f "$tmpm/JOB.md"

tmpc="$(mktemp -d)"; go run ./cmd/telltail cloud gcp spec --project gary-agent-yard --region europe-west2 --image example.invalid/telltail-worker:0.3 --command "echo ok" --service-account gary-batch-worker@gary-agent-yard.iam.gserviceaccount.com --out "$tmpc/job.json" && grep -q 'gary-batch-worker@gary-agent-yard.iam.gserviceaccount.com' "$tmpc/job.json"
